description: Speech prices for the Deepgram condition: Nova-3 speech-to-text and Aura-2 text-to-speech in all three versions (run_spec.py --speech-prices).

stt.billed: per minute of audio streamed; the driver streams continuously, silence included
stt.source: https://deepgram.com/pricing, pay as you go, read 2026-10-01: Nova-3 streaming 'Regular price $0.0077/min' (0.462 USD per hour), shown with a 'Current price $0.0048/min'; priced here at the regular price

tts.billed: per character synthesised; priced here on the bot text in the agent's conversation record, so a phrase served from Rasa's TTS cache is still counted (an upper bound)
tts.source: https://deepgram.com/pricing, pay as you go, read 2026-10-01: Aura-2 $0.030/1k characters
